notes.title: Another Roguelike Farm - Update Notes (Aug 8)
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! [/p][p][/p][p]We’ve made a few small updates to improve your overall gaming experience. Check out the latest fixes:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Nesting of descriptions restored with changed behaviour - now you have to right-click to nest.[/p][/*][*][p]Game freezing issue fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Auto-assign when selecting days now requires holding Ctrl.[/p][/*][*][p]Buying an entire slot of items in the shop now requires holding Ctrl.[/p][/*][*][p]Fish Sandwich: energy reduced from 100 → 75.[/p][/*][*][p]Golden Fish Sandwich: energy reduced from 200 → 150.[/p][/*][*][p]Number of animals whose life is increased by Catfish reduced from 5 → 3[/p][/*][*][p]Number of animals whose life is increased by Baked Catfish reduced from 7 → 6, and the duration of the life increase reduced from 3 → 2[/p][/*][*][p]Yellowfin Tuna: uses reduced from 3 → 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Baked Yellowfin Tuna: uses reduced from 4 → 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Pufferfish: uses reduced from 3 → 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Baked Pufferfish: uses reduced from 6 → 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed keyword collisions for certain items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Wizard started with Fragility -1.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Builder had Beekeeper’s XP bonus from the honey.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected some Polish descriptions.[/p][/*][*][p]Money earned from Pirate Coins and Brains now correctly adds to the money earned statistics.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Jungle biome description so that it now shows it also unlocks Camellia and Horsetail seeds[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]We truly appreciate all your support and feedback, it means a lot to us and helps the game keep getting better![/p][p][/p][p]Happy gaming, and stay tuned for more updates![/p]

tags.bug: Nesting of descriptions restored with changed behaviour - now you have to right-click to nest.
Game freezing issue fixed.
Auto-assign when selecting days now requires holding Ctrl.
Buying an entire slot of items in the shop now requires holding Ctrl.

tags.balance_change: Golden Fish Sandwich: energy reduced from 200 → 150.
Number of animals whose life is increased by Catfish reduced from 5 → 3
Number of animals whose life is increased by Baked Catfish reduced from 7 → 6, and the duration of the life increase reduced from 3 → 2
Baked Yellowfin Tuna: uses reduced from 4 → 3.

tags.bug: Fixed keyword collisions for certain items.
Fixed a bug where the Wizard started with Fragility -1.
Fixed a bug where the Builder had Beekeeper’s XP bonus from the honey.
Corrected some Polish descriptions.
Money earned from Pirate Coins and Brains now correctly adds to the money earned statistics.

tags.feature: Updated the Jungle biome description so that it now shows it also unlocks Camellia and Horsetail seeds

notes.title: 🌾 Another Roguelike Farm - Update Notes (Aug 6)
notes.content: [p]Hey guys, [/p][p]We’ve been closely following everything you’ve shared, from Steam reviews to community discussions. Every message, whether it’s encouragement or constructive criticism, means a lot and helps us move in the right direction.[/p][p]The team is working hard behind the scenes, and here's a look at what’s been updated:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]When you win a game as the Genie and then go into Endless mode, you no longer receive a second lamp.[/p][/*][*][p]Max EXP now correctly saves and loads.[/p][/*][*][p]In the tutorial, the game correctly advances to the next step after using a consumable.[/p][/*][*][p]Rent now loads properly.[/p][/*][*][p]The hoe can now be used even if the center tile is occupied by a building.[/p][/*][*][p]The Shaman no longer loses their totem, and poison status on breakables now saves correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]The "Exit" button has been removed from the in-run menu (but still appears in the regular menu).[/p][/*][*][p]When returning to the main menu during a run, the game now automatically saves.[/p][/*][*][p]When returning a fence to its original position with RMB, the animals associated with it are also restored properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some descriptions in English[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some descriptions in Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Crop values now load correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Flower values now load correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Animal product values now load correctly[/p][/*][*][p]The Wisdom Hunt challenge no longer completes without being finished[/p][/*][*][p]The token animation now correctly appears after completing the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fisherman level gains adjusted:[/p][/*][/list][p]Fish Chance 5% → 3%[/p][p]Max Energy 10 → 5[/p][list][*][p]Angler level gains adjusted:[/p][/*][/list][p]Fish Chance 5% → 3%[/p][list][*][p]Angler now starts with -25% fish chance[/p][/*][*][p]Base Fish Chance changed from 50% → 45%[/p][/*][*][p]The chocolate watering can no longer crashes the game when watering trees[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer continue into Endless Mode without winning the game first[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We know the game still has room to grow, and your feedback is what helps us improve every single day. Thank you for sticking with us![/p]

notes.title: 🌾 Another Roguelike Farm - Update Notes (Aug 5)
notes.content: [p]Hey guys,[/p][p]Thank you all for your feedback and suggestions across social media, Steam reviews, and our community channels. We’ve seen your comments — the good, the critical, and everything in between — and we’re taking them seriously.[/p][p][/p][p]Our update plans are in full swing, and while it will take some time to address everything properly, we are steadily making improvements. We truly appreciate your patience and hope you’ll stick with us as we continue refining the game.[/p][p][/p][h3]🔍 Today’s Update[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed all currently known bugs that could cause crashes[/p][/*][*][p]Character class unlocking has been reworked — you no longer need to earn a specific number of tokens from certain difficulty levels. Instead, total token count now unlocks characters, so no more beating the highest difficulty just to try new builds![/p][/*][*][p]When a building is already placed, right-clicking it will return it to its original location[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where clicking the hourglass multiple times during day transitions could charge rent more than once[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing a shortcut key for a menu (F1, F2, F3, etc.) now switches menus instead of closing them all[/p][/*][*][p]Keywords in the apple description now have proper collision detection[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the scarecrow didn’t work properly when off-screen[/p][/*][*][p]The Hex Brew potion now correctly gives only low-level alchemy items[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the description of the "Grill Fish" perk[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We know there’s still a long way to go, and we are committed to making [i]Another Roguelike Farm[/i] better with every update. Thanks again for being here with us.[/p]

tags.bug: Fixed all currently known bugs that could cause crashes

tags.feature: Character class unlocking has been reworked — you no longer need to earn a specific number of tokens from certain difficulty levels. Instead, total token count now unlocks characters, so no more beating the highest difficulty just to try new builds!
When a building is already placed, right-clicking it will return it to its original location

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where clicking the hourglass multiple times during day transitions could charge rent more than once
Pressing a shortcut key for a menu (F1, F2, F3, etc.) now switches menus instead of closing them all
Keywords in the apple description now have proper collision detection
Fixed a bug where the scarecrow didn’t work properly when off-screen
The Hex Brew potion now correctly gives only low-level alchemy items
Fixed the description of the "Grill Fish" perk

notes.title: 🌱 First Patch: Freshly Picked Fixes & Tweaks!
notes.content: [p]Hey guys,[/p][p]Thank you all so much for jumping into [i]Another Farm Roguelike: Rebirth[/i]! We’ve been thrilled (and a little overwhelmed) watching you build chaotic farms and break the economy in the most creative ways possible.[/p][p]This first patch focuses on squashing some early bugs, balancing a few overgrown mechanics, and improving your overall (surviving) experience. It's just the beginning, more is coming soon.[/p][p][/p][h3]🪴Here’s what’s new in this update:[/h3][list][*][p]Added selectable 2K and 4K resolution options.[/p][/*][*][p]Cactus price adjusted from 150–200 → now 25–50.[/p][/*][*][p]The Hungerless perk now properly appears as a selectable option for the Butcher class.[/p][/*][*][p]Zombie sound volume has been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]The game now notes.title: Demo Update & Participation in Steam's Chinese New Year Sale!
notes.content:
[h1]Demo Update:[/h1]

[h2]New Things[/h2]
[list]
[*] After leveling up, you can hover over the icon of the statistic that increases with each level to see what it does.
[*] A mini-tutorial upon entering the game.
[*] When hovering over a keyword in the character or perk selection, its description is displayed.
[*] When hovering over a character increment, its name and description are displayed.
[*] Added cooking and alchemy.
[*] Added Simplified Chinese language to the game.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Using the hoe and watering can gives 1 XP.
[*] Backpack size increased from 32 to 48.
[*] The value of items in the shop cannot be lower than their maximum selling value.
[*] Visual rework of quests.
[*] There is only one weekly quest, but you can choose between two options.
[*] The quest now appears between days 2 and 5 instead of days 2 and 7.
[*] Some UI elements have been graphically improved.
[*] The sprites for stones and polished stones have been changed to avoid confusion with other items.
[*] The volume of some SFX has been adjusted.
[*] Totems have been removed.
[*] Level thresholds have been adjusted.
[*] The maximum starting energy has been reduced from 225 to 150.
[*] Starting money has been increased from 150 to 200.
[*] Big balance changes.
[*] Added quantities to recipe tooltips, e.g., it now shows that smelting one sand produces three glass.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Corrected instances of incorrect text.
[*] Resolved an exploit allowing unlimited animals in pens outside the camera area.
[*] Buildings can no longer be placed outside the map boundaries.
[*] Rent values now reset correctly between runs.
[*] Fixed water rendering over buildings and trees.
[*] Various tutorial-related bugs have been addressed.
[*] Berry Jam Fix: Now restores energy and increases max energy.
[*] Tool Energy Costs: Properly reduced when using Orange Juice.
[*] Fixed an issue where quest choice appearances canceled the auto-harvest effect.
[*] Leveling up a tool now displays the correct icon.
[*] Selling Improvements: Items in the shop, building, and crafting tabs can now be sold by holding RMB (just like in the inventory).
[*] Fixed a bug allowing players to gain two levels at once.
[/list]

Finally, we are excited to share with everyone that 𝐀𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐅𝐚𝐫𝐦 𝐑𝐨𝐠𝐮𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐤𝐞: 𝐑𝐞𝐛𝐢𝐫𝐭𝐡 will participate in the Steam Chinese New Year Sale! More players will soon be visiting our farm!

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
[h1]New Things[/h1]
[list]
[*] 10 New Perks
[*] Mini Events with quests
[*] Stats tab is now available
[*] The perks available to choose from after leveling up depend on the player's level
[*] New building category with 8 buildings
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Bowl type - [b]Resource -> Container[/b]
[*] Starting backpack space [b]16 -> 32[/b]
[*] Increasing backpack space for money has been removed
[*] The perk Connections no longer increases backpack space; instead, it changes rent value by [b]-5%[/b]
[*] The perks Scholar and Traditionalist can be obtained at levels 2 and 3 instead of only at level 2
[*] The perk Neo Diet also increases the amount of fertilizer produced by animals
[*] When gaining or losing stats from quests, a text popup will appear
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Cursor is visible again in the settings
[*] The poison recipe displays correctly
[*] The sheep icon has been fixed
[*] The hitboxes of some buildings have been corrected
[*] When selecting a genie and changing pages with classes, the game no longer crashes
[*] Haste displays correctly in stats tab
[*] The Fragility perk also changes the HP of what spawns after taking it, such as stumps
[*] The Hungerless perk also changes the lifespan of current animals in the fence
[*] The Magic Tools perk now upgrades a random path instead of always the first one
[*] Events that deduct experience now subtract it correctly
[*] The event Catch 100 fish now increases building time as a reward instead of decreasing it
[*] The event Bake 25 fish now increases craft requirements instead of decreasing them
[*] The event Build 2 Fences now correctly requires 2 fences instead of 1
[/list]

notes.title: Changes from the last week
notes.content:
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] After clicking the menu or exit button, a confirmation prompt appears asking if you're sure you want to proceed
[*] The background color and some sprites from the swamp and mountains have been changed

[/list]

notes.title: Difficulty adjustments & Bug fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Difficulty Adjustments[/h1]
As the value of 80 000 isn't a significant challenge for experienced players, I'm reducing it to [b]45 000[/b] so that less experienced players are able to complete the demo
[list]
[*] Max Energy 200 --> [b]225[/b]
[*] Rent 5000/80000 --> [b]2500/45000[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The repeated use of the fish no longer prevents completing the tutorial
[*] Fixed hitboxes for apple and orange trees
[*] Added a delay in the perk selection to prevent accidental selection if someone is playing with visual effects disabled
[*] Fixed Rose Hoe description
[*] The hammer receives the appropriate amount of experience regardless of the biome
[*] Various experience bugs fixed
[*] The Preserved Pumpkin and Orange Juice change the cost in the tool description
[*] Fixed an issue with using consumables when the cursor was on the hotbar
[/list]
[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] The chance of stones appearing in the Plain biome has been increased
[*] Mystical Fertilizer is back
[*] Character class unlock sound effect adjusted
[*] Minor tutorial improvement
[/list]

notes.title: April 19th - Demo release
notes.content:
[h1][b]Welcome fellow farmers[/b][/h1]

[h2]About[/h2]
The first version of the demo will be released on April 19th and will contain: 
[list]
[*] 3 Character classes with a total of 6 variants
[*] 3 Biomes
[*] 1 Game mode 
[*] 5 Cute animals ^^
[/list]
[h2]What's next[/h2]
Next things I plan to add to the demo (in no particular order) are:
[list]
[*] Save & Load (Multiple saves)
[*] Alchemy & Cooking
[*] In-game stat tab where you can check various things like item prices, taken perks, stats (e.g., fish catch chance or exp boost)
[*] Automation
[*] NPCs
[*] Mini events (hard to explain, you'll see ^^)
[*] Zooming in and out camera
[*] Customizable controls
[*] New content to existing biomes
[/list]
At the top of the list will be various adjustments that result from your feedback.

That's all for now. Good luck on the farm.
